Metadata.title: Emma & Éléa — Production, costs and traceability for artisan food businesses
Metadata.description: One app for recipes, production, stock, teams, costs and traceability. Produce just right, sell better and protect your margins.

hero.title: Produce just right. Sell better.
hero.intro: One app that connects your recipes, production, stock, teams, costs and traceability — so you can protect your margins from raw material to finished product.
hero.audiences: Bakeries · Pastry shops · Butcher shops · Delicatessens · Caterers

reality.title: Too much of the workshop still runs on memory.
reality.intro: Demanding daily production, fresh products with short shelf lives, rising costs, hard-to-recruit staff and price pressure. Much of the organisation still lives in spreadsheets, notebooks and handwritten notes — so decisions get made on intuition.

costs.title: Rising costs erode margins
costs.body: Flour, butter, meat, energy, wages: prices move, but which product is becoming less profitable is harder to see.

waste.title: Food waste costs twice
waste.body: Producing too much loses materials, time and margin. Producing too little loses sales and disappoints customers.

team.title: Team organisation slows you down
team.body: Schedules, absences and workload shifts take time away from production and from running the business.

stock.title: Stock and traceability escape control
stock.body: Hundreds of references, short shelf lives, stock-outs, emergency purchases and batches to track from receipt to finished product.

profitability.title: Real profitability stays invisible
profitability.body: Turnover is known. The real cost and margin of each baguette, cut of meat or caterer’s dish often is not.

tools.title: Digital tools are too complex
tools.body: Software built for checkout, accounting or large-scale retail adds training and manual entry instead of saving time.

product.title: One workspace, from raw material to finished product.
product.intro: Emma & Éléa does not replace your know-how. It automates the administrative and organisational side of production, so you can move from “what are we missing today?” to “what should I produce, with which ingredients, with which team, and at what margin?”

recipes.title: Recipes & cost prices
recipes.body: Automatic cost prices including ingredients, losses, packaging and labour. Margins update when a purchase price changes.

production.title: Production & forecasting
production.body: Suggested quantities based on sales history, orders, seasonality, days of the week and local events.

stock.title: Stock & traceability
stock.body: Real-time stock, ingredient requirements, batches, expiry dates, replenishment alerts and inspection-ready records.

team.title: Teams & schedules
team.body: Skills, availability and workload in one place, with tasks assigned to the right people and conflicts made visible.

margins.title: Margins & profitability
margins.body: Compare products by profitability, volume and loss rate, and decide whether to adjust a price, a recipe or a supplier.

simple.title: Simple by design
simple.body: Fast in the workshop on computer, tablet or mobile, with progressive integration into checkout, scales and label printers.

benefits.title: Less guesswork. More margin.
benefits.intro: Concrete gains, at the pace of the workshop.

produce.title: Produce just right
produce.body: Reduce unsold items through better quantity forecasting.

margins.title: Protect margins
margins.body: Know the real cost and profitability of every product.

time.title: Save time
time.body: Automate calculations, schedules, alerts and raw material requirements.

team.title: Organise the team better
team.body: Distribute workload and limit organisational errors.

losses.title: Reduce losses
losses.body: Track use-by dates, stock and unsold items.

finalCta.title: Ready to produce just right?
finalCta.intro: Start with your recipes and cost prices. The rest follows: production, stock, teams and traceability, in one place.
finalCta.audiences: Built for bakeries, pastry shops, butcher shops, delicatessens and caterers.

footer.tagline: Produce just right, sell better and protect your margins.
footer.audience: Bakeries, pastry shops, butcher shops, delicatessens, caterers and artisan food businesses.
